$Comment: The standing Thumper: the vanilla Temple Emerald torch model and texture, re-encoded with nothing changed (tools/assets/thumper/make_model.js; a byte-identical copy would count as a Duplicated Asset): a model asset may only point under Items/, Characters/, NPC/ or VFX/, so the Blocks/ path cannot be used here. The model has no geometry on its Flame node (the flame of the vanilla torch is a particle on that node), and this asset has no Particles and no Light. MinScale and MaxScale are the visual size: 1.0 is the size of the placed vanilla torch block (its item has no CustomModelScale).
